_about: Models to generate with tools/meshy/meshy.py, in model-queue order (docs/art/model-queue.md). id = the game's id; kind = nodes or buildings; variants = name -> extra description (each variant is its own model). Optional prompt_suffix / texture_suffix override the shared style for one asset. Optional retired = a list of variant names made once and taken out of the game: they are never made, previewed or refined again.

A sand mage, a woman scholar-sorceress of a late-medieval age: a long pale linen robe with wide trailing sleeves, a short mantle with a tall stiff collar edged in brass, a wrapped headscarf and a light face veil, a broad sash hung with a small brass bell, a violet aether crystal in a brass clasp at her throat, sandals; nothing in her hands

A fire siphoneer of the Arsenal, a stocky man: a long leather coat with a bronze-scaled apron, leather gauntlets, an open bronze helmet over a padded hood with round goggles, a riveted bronze tank of liquid fire strapped upright on his back, tall boots; nothing in his hands

A hand-held liquid-fire siphon: a bronze tube about a metre long with a flared muzzle cast as an open beast's mouth, a pump lever along the top, a short copper pressure chamber under the barrel, two wooden hand grips

A Paladin, a holy knight of a late-medieval age, seated on a heavy warhorse, both standing still and facing forward with all four hooves planted: the knight in gilded plate armour with a great helm and a short cape, a pale crystal relic set in the breastplate, a long-hafted war hammer with a sun-disc head held upright in the right hand; the horse with a steel chanfron and a plain caparison edged in gold

A rune cannon, a field gun of an early gunpowder age: a long thick bronze barrel banded with blackened iron and inlaid along its length with a line of deep-cut runes, a heavy carved-stone breech block, on a low sturdy timber carriage with two big iron-rimmed spoked wheels and a trail resting on the ground behind, the barrel pointing forward

A star druid, an old grey-bearded man who reads the fallen star: a long hooded robe of undyed wool belted with rope, a mantle of bark and moss over the shoulders, a pair of small stag antlers rising from the hood, a bronze torc, a violet crystal shard hanging on a cord at his chest, a satchel of herbs at the hip, leather sandals; nothing in his hands

A druid's staff about two metres long: a gnarled shaft of living oak with a few fresh leaves sprouting from it, its top branching into a crown of twisted roots that cradles a large violet star crystal, bronze rings bound around the grip

A sunglass engine: a great round parabolic mirror of silvered quartz glass in a ribbed brass frame, upright on a pivoting brass yoke and facing forward, a violet aether crystal held at its focus on three thin brass struts, mounted on a sturdy four-wheeled timber cart with iron-rimmed spoked wheels

A Reliquary Ark, a floating shrine of a late-medieval age, hovering a hand's breadth above the ground: a long gabled reliquary like a small chapel, of carved timber clad in brass and gold with arched panels along its sides, a large pale crystal enshrined under an open gilded cupola on the roof, a short row of brass organ pipes behind it, a pointed prow at the front, no wheels and no legs

A sky shaman, a weathered older woman seated on a shaggy steppe horse, both standing still and facing forward with all four hooves planted: a long felt robe hung with fringes and small round silver mirrors, a headdress of feathers and horn, a frame drum slung on her back, a falconer's gauntlet on her left arm, a tall staff held upright crowned with silver hawk wings around a violet star crystal; the horse with a felt saddle cloth

A quartz sifting works on a square footprint, very low and flat: shallow sandstone basins of pale sand, timber frames holding large rocking sieves, two knee-high domed clay kilns with curved brass mirrors angled toward them, heaps of sorted glassy quartz grains and woven baskets

A khan's palace tent on a square footprint: a huge round felt yurt with a gently domed roof and a raised crown ring at its peak, gold-stitched borders and knot patterns on the felt, two smaller round yurts joined to its sides, a wide carved wooden doorway under a fringed awning, a railed archer platform around the crown ring

A sacred grove on a square footprint, the holy heart of a forest clan in the years after the star fell: a massive ancient oak with a broad crown and great twisting roots, violet aether crystals grown into its trunk and roots, ringed by tall rough standing stones carved with spirals, a flat stone altar at the oak's foot

A walled shipyard on a square footprint: high crenellated brick walls around two long boat-sheds with gabled tile roofs side by side over covered slipways, the bow of a galley under construction showing from one shed, a tall timber crane, a grand arched water gate between two square towers at the front

A cathedral on a square footprint, raised in an age of brass and clockwork around a great shard of the fallen star: a cross-shaped nave of pale dressed stone with tall pointed windows, flying buttresses and a steep roof, a great rose window over the front doors, corner pinnacles, a tall central spire crowned by a huge violet aether crystal held in gold claws

A slender tower on a small square footprint: a tall tapering sandstone tower with pointed-arch windows and a small balcony near the top, crowned by a large concave mirror of polished brass and glass on a tilting yoke, a violet aether crystal set at the mirror's centre

A squat tower on a small square footprint: thick stone walls lined with bronze plates and copper bands, a flat crenellated top with a long bronze siphon nozzle on a swivel aimed down over the parapet, a big riveted copper tank with a hand pump beside it, copper pipes running down the walls

A squat six-sided bastion filling a square footprint, built in the first age of aether-powder guns: thick sloping walls of massive cut stone bound with iron bands and cut with deep runes, a jutting parapet with murder holes all around the top, a covered crossbow gallery with narrow loops below it, a short heavy rune-carved gun of dark riveted iron and brass on a turning mount on the flat roof

A laboratory on a square footprint: a two-storey hall of dressed stone and riveted iron with tall arched windows, a dome of glass panes in a brass frame on one corner, a tall brass mast topped with a large quartz sphere, a glazed annex along one side holding rows of tall brass cabinet engines, pipes running to a small boiler house

An engine works on a square footprint: a huge factory hall of riveted iron and brick on a stone base, a sawtooth roof of glazed skylights, three tall smokestacks, a boiler house with big pipes along one side, a heavy gantry crane over an open assembly bay, enormous sliding doors at the front

An airfield on a rectangular footprint, very low and flat: a long flat runway of timber boards and riveted iron plates along one side, a low arched hangar of corrugated iron on a riveted frame beside it with wide open doors, a small control hut on stilts, fuel drums and a refuelling tank

A flak battery on a square footprint, low and wide: a round emplacement of stone and riveted iron plate with a sloped armoured rim, two long-barrelled flak guns side by side on one turning mount pointing steeply upward, racks of shells and ammunition boxes inside the rim, a small armoured hatch

A straight segment of the same castle wall rebuilt heavier, three times as long as it is thick: a sloped base and a thick wall of grey ferro-concrete faced with riveted iron plates, a walkway along the top behind a crenellated parapet with iron-shuttered firing slits; both ends cut perfectly flat and plain so segments join seamlessly, no towers or posts at the ends

A straight segment of the same castle wall rebuilt heavier, with one large gate in the middle, seven and a half times as long as it is thick: a sloped base and a thick ferro-concrete wall faced with riveted iron plates, a crenellated parapet along the top, a wide square gateway taking up about half the length, closed by a heavy riveted blast door that slides sideways on a rail; both ends cut perfectly flat and plain so segments join seamlessly, no towers or posts at the ends

A gun turret on a small square footprint, the same stone tower clad for war: a tall square tower faced with riveted iron plates over the stone, pipes and a ladder up one side, a round armoured turret on a turning ring at the top with a low domed roof, twin autocannon barrels with a drum magazine pointing forward and up

An engineer, a skilled worker with steam tools: a sturdy woman in a canvas work coat with rolled sleeves under a heavy leather apron, a leather cap with brass goggles, thick work gloves, a tool belt with wrenches and pouches, a small riveted boiler pack on her back with a pressure gauge and a short exhaust pipe, heavy boots; nothing in her hands

A heavy work axe about 90 cm long: a thick ash haft with iron bands and a rubberised leather grip, a broad blackened-iron axe head with a flat hammer face on the back, a short brass piston fitted along the top of the head

A rifleman of a rifle squad: a steady soldier in a riveted steel breastplate over a long canvas greatcoat, a round brimmed steel helmet, leather cartridge pouches on a wide belt, a rolled blanket slung across his chest, a canteen on the hip, puttees and hobnailed boots; nothing in his hands

A long rifle about 1.3 metres long: a slim blackened-iron barrel on a full-length wooden stock bound with brass bands, a bolt action with a small brass handle, a box magazine under the action, an iron sight at the muzzle and a short bayonet fixed beneath it

A rocket battery: a heavy four-wheeled steam wagon with riveted iron sides and a small boiler and smokestack at the back, carrying a tilted launch rack of twelve long iron rockets with brass nose cones and tail fins, the rack pointing forward and up over the front of the wagon

A flak wagon: an armoured four-wheeled steam wagon of riveted iron plate with a boiler stack at the back, carrying on its bed a turntable mount with two long flak cannon barrels side by side behind a curved gun shield, the barrels pointing forward and steeply up at the sky

A gatling gunner: a big, barrel-chested man in a heavy riveted iron breastplate over a padded canvas jacket, a leather cap with ear flaps and goggles, thick leather gauntlets, a large riveted ammunition drum carried on his back in a leather harness, a belt of pouches, heavy boots; nothing in his hands

A hand-cranked gatling gun about 1.3 metres long: six iron barrels in a rotating cluster held by brass rings, a boxy brass-and-iron breech housing with a crank handle on its side, a drum magazine on top, a rear grip and a carrying handle

A steam landship: a long rhomboid hull of riveted iron plates with caterpillar tracks running all the way around its sides, a squat turret on top with a short heavy cannon pointing forward, a sponson on each side carrying a flame-projector nozzle, a tall boiler smokestack and pipes at the back, narrow vision slits at the front

A gyrocopter in level flight: a small open frame of riveted iron tubes around a wooden seat, a long two-blade rotor spread overhead on a mast, a pusher propeller behind driven by a compact boiler engine, a small tail fin, twin forward guns under the nose, a pilot in a leather flying cap and goggles in the open seat; nothing touching the ground

A biplane bomber in level flight: two long stacked wings of canvas over wooden ribs braced with struts and taut wires, a boxy wood-and-canvas fuselage with a tail fin, a chunky engine with a big wooden propeller at the nose, an open cockpit with a pilot in a leather flying cap and goggles, round iron bombs hung in racks under the lower wing

A shock trooper, a knight in steam-plate: a towering man in heavy riveted plate armour with thick rounded pauldrons and big gauntlets, a closed helm with a narrow visor slit, a small riveted boiler on his back with two short exhaust pipes and pressure gauges, copper cables running from it to the gauntlets, armoured boots; nothing in his hands

A galvanic war maul about 1.2 metres long: a thick iron haft with a rubberised leather grip, a huge blocky hammer head of blackened iron wrapped in copper coil windings, two glass capacitor tubes set along the top of the head, an iron pommel

A veiled guardsman, slim and fast: a knee-length coat of quilted silk over light lamellar, a turban with a face veil of fine brass mesh, a round brass veil emitter on the chest, thin brass ribs curving over the shoulders; nothing in his hands
A khanjar: a long, sharply curved double-edged dagger blade of dark steel with a raised central rib, a brass hilt with a wide flared pommel and a small crossguard, a grip of ribbed horn

A lightblade of an industrial age: a long straight sword whose blade is a single piece of pale crystal like solid light, an ornate gilded hilt with a wide crossguard shaped like a star's rays, a white-enamelled grip bound in gold wire, a round crystal pommel

A rocket rider seated on a sturdy steppe horse, both standing still and facing forward with all four hooves planted: the rider in riveted iron lamellar over a quilted coat, a fur-trimmed cap with goggles pushed up, a heavy composite bow held upright in the left hand; behind the saddle a tall iron rack of finned rocket arrows in tubes

A crystal ranger, a veteran forest warden, a lean woman: a hooded cloak of mottled wool thrown back, a close-fitting jerkin of overlapping hardened-leather scales grained like bark, bronze bracers, a belt of pouches, a small violet crystal set in a bronze clasp at her throat, tall soft boots; nothing in her hands

A crystal stave: a smooth, slightly curved yew stave about one and a half metres long, its head split into living branches that grip a long clear violet crystal grown into the wood like a lens, a leather-wrapped grip, a few small leaves sprouting along the shaft

A Steamplate Thane in huge steam-driven power armour: thick riveted plates, massive pauldrons, pistons at the elbows and knees, a boiler backpack with two exhaust stacks, a domed helm with a visor slit over a braided beard; nothing in his hands

A piston hammer: a long iron haft with a leather-wrapped grip, a massive block-shaped hammer head of riveted iron with a steam piston running through it and a flat striking face at each end, a small steam cylinder and valve on top of the head

An ironclad crawler: a low armoured casemate hull like a river ironclad's, sloped sides of riveted iron plates with a copper-sheathed lower edge, a short heavy cannon in a forward gun port, two torpedo tubes in the bow below it, a squat smokestack on the roof, six jointed crab legs with pointed feet planted on the ground, at rest and facing forward

A brass diver, a marine in a heavy diving suit: a round brass helmet with three glass portholes bolted to a riveted copper breastplate, a bulky rubberised canvas suit, a compact air tank on his back, a belt of lead weights, lead-soled boots, thick leather gloves; nothing in his hands

A galvanic harpoon gun: a short heavy brass barrel wound with copper coils, a barbed copper harpoon loaded in the muzzle, a wooden stock and pistol grip, a small glass battery jar fixed under the barrel

A seraph, a winged warrior-monk of an industrial age, in level flight with the body leaning forward and the legs trailing: light white-enamelled plate over a long robe, an open-faced gilded helm with a small star crest, two great wings of overlapping brass feather-plates on a riveted frame spread wide from a back harness, a pale crystal at the harness hub, a short crystal-tipped rod held forward in the right hand, nothing touching the ground

An ornithopter in level flight: a boat-shaped fuselage of riveted brass and canvas with one goggled pilot in an open cockpit, two long jointed canvas wings on brass ribs spread wide like a bird's, a coiled spring-drum behind the pilot, a fan tail, round glass bombs slung under the belly, nothing touching the ground

A rootbreaker: a wild boar swollen to the size of a wagon, a massive humped body with a bristling dark mane along its spine, short thick legs, curved yellowed tusks, a great battering ram of thick living roots grown over its skull and snout like a helmet with small violet crystals in the roots, standing in a natural pose with four feet planted and head forward

A breacher, a walking siege drill: a squat armoured body of riveted iron plates on four short, thick jointed legs with broad feet, a huge conical mine drill with spiral flutes jutting from the front, a boiler stack on its back, vision slits above the drill, low and heavy like an iron beetle, facing forward

A thornback: a bulky four-legged beast grown from bramble and living wood, a broad low body of twisted woody vines and bark, its back covered in a dense mass of long iron-hard thorns pointing forward and up, a heavy blunt head with a wide mouth full of thorns, thick root-like legs, standing in a natural pose with four feet planted and head forward

The same squat six-sided stone bastion grown into the age of steam, filling a square footprint: thick sloping cut-stone walls bound with riveted iron and cut with deep runes, the jutting parapet with murder holes, the heavy rune-carved gun on the flat roof beside a short iron rune-spire of stacked copper rings with a pointed lightning tip, steam pipes down the walls

The same wagon laager on a square footprint, low and wide: four heavy war-wagons in a closed square ring chained wheel to wheel, their tall side boards faced with riveted iron plates and firing slits, a crank-handled gatling gun with a cluster of barrels mounted over the boards of each wagon, ammunition boxes in the open middle

A starport on a square footprint: a broad raised landing deck of dark metal plates on a heavy riveted frame, a large round landing pad in its middle, two tall curved gantry arms rising over the pad from opposite sides, a slim control tower on one corner, wide hangar doors in the sides of the deck

A shield generator on a square footprint: a heavy forged base of dark metal plates on a riveted frame, a tall round dynamo column rising from it wrapped in thick copper coils, four curved emitter prongs around its top holding a large violet aether crystal, thin blue lines along the coils and the prongs

A straight segment of the same castle wall in its final form, three times as long as it is thick: a sloped base and a solid wall of dark forged metal plates over a riveted frame, a crenellated parapet with a walkway, two short squat pylons rising from the parapet at a third and two thirds of its length, linked by a thin band of blue light; both ends cut perfectly flat and plain so segments join seamlessly, no towers or posts at the ends

A straight segment of the same castle wall in its final form, with one large gate in the middle, seven and a half times as long as it is thick: a sloped base and a solid wall of dark forged metal plates over a riveted frame, a crenellated parapet, a wide square gateway taking up about half the length between two squat pylons, spanned by a few thin horizontal bands of blue light; both ends cut perfectly flat and plain so segments join seamlessly, no towers or posts at the ends

A plasma turret on a small square footprint, the same tower in its last form: a tall square tower sheathed in dark polished plates over the old riveted frame, a round turret near the top carrying a long plasma lance barrel with a crystal focusing lens at its muzzle, a slim pointed spire above it, a ring of small shield emitters around the turret

A shield trooper: a heavily armoured soldier in dark adamant mail under smooth fitted plates at the chest, shoulders and shins, a closed rounded helmet with a narrow visor, a compact power pack on his back with two short emitter fins, armoured gloves and heavy boots; nothing in his hands

A plasma carbine about 90 cm long: a short, chunky gun with a smooth dark metal body over a riveted frame, a thick barrel shroud with cooling fins ending in a wide muzzle with a focusing ring, a pistol grip and a short shoulder stock, a round energy cell set in its side

A tall adamant shield about 1.2 metres high: a curved rectangular slab of dark adamant plates over a riveted frame, a narrow horizontal viewing slot near the top, a round emitter core in the centre with thin lines running out to the edges, a grip and arm brace on the back

A gunship in level flight: a broad, heavily armoured hull of dark plates with a blunt nose and a narrow cockpit window, two stub wings carrying boxy missile pods with rows of round launch tubes facing forward, four tilted thruster pods at the wing tips and tail, a short tail boom with twin fins; nothing touching the ground

A plasma artillery piece: a low tracked armoured carriage carrying a huge short-barrelled mortar with a wide round muzzle angled up toward the front, the barrel ringed with gold coils around a crystal firing chamber, heavy recoil pistons beside it, armoured side skirts over the tracks

A star bomber in level flight: a wide, flat sky barge with a hull of dark adamant ribs and plates shaped like a broad boat keel, short swept wings along its sides, a raised armoured bridge at the front with narrow windows, an open bomb bay underneath holding a row of violet aether charges in brass cradles, engine nozzles across the back

A storm walker: a tall two-legged war machine on thick forward-bending armoured legs with broad feet, a heavy rounded armoured torso with a narrow visor slit, a long railgun of two parallel rails mounted on the right shoulder pointing forward, a tesla coil tower of stacked copper rings topped by a metal sphere on the left shoulder, standing upright and facing forward

A starfighter in level flight: a single-seat needle fighter with a long, narrow pointed fuselage, short swept-back wings, a small glass canopy set far back, two slim pulse-laser barrels on the wing tips pointing forward, a pair of engine nozzles at the tail and two small tail fins; nothing touching the ground

A drone in level flight: a small round thinking-engine drone the size of a shield, a domed hull of dark metal plates with gold rims, four small ducted fans around its sides, a single round glass lens eye at the front, two short zapper prongs pointing forward under the eye; nothing touching the ground

A titan: a towering humanoid war colossus of dark adamant plates over a riveted frame, broad armoured shoulders, a small hunched head with a narrow visor, the right forearm ending in a huge star cannon barrel ringed with gold coils with a crystal lens at its muzzle pointing forward, a massive armoured left fist, thick pillar legs on broad feet, standing upright and facing forward

A Runeguard, an elite hold warrior of an advanced future age: broad and stocky in full plate of dark polished adamant over a riveted frame, deep-cut runes down the breastplate and gauntlets, wide layered pauldrons, a closed helm with a T-shaped visor and a braided steel beard; nothing in his hands

A thunder-rune axe of an advanced future age: a long haft of dark metal wrapped in leather at the grip, a broad crescent axe head of dark polished adamant with runes inlaid deep along the blade, a round carved rune stone set at the centre of the head, a short spike on top

A phaser marine, a fit soldier: close-fitting armour of overlapping polished lamellar plates over a padded suit, a rounded helmet with a narrow visor and a low copper crest, a compact shield generator pack on his back, a belt of pouches, armoured boots; no shield, and nothing in his hands
A phaser: a compact beam rifle with a long slim barrel ringed with cooling fins, a small crystal focusing lens at the muzzle, a short stock and a pistol grip, a slim power cell under the barrel

A sandskiff: a low, flat, boat-shaped hover hull with an upturned prow and gold trim, floating just above the ground on rows of small brass resonator bells underneath, a large flared brass horn cannon on a swivel mount on top pointing forward, a small enclosed cockpit canopy of brass ribs and glass at the stern, no sail and no wheels

A skyrider on a repulsor bike hovering just above the ground, both still and facing forward: a narrow hull of dark polished plates with a high saddle and stirrups, a prow curving up like a horse's neck, two repulsor pads underneath, a horse-tail tassel at the rear, no wheels; the rider in polished lamellar and a fur-trimmed helmet, a short carbine held upright

An Orbital Lance, a hovering mirror-altar of a far-advanced age, floating just above the ground: a long altar-like hull of dark polished metal with white-enamelled panels and gold trim, a great round concave mirror of polished gold raised on a pivoting arm at the back and tilted forward and up, a tall pale crystal spike at the mirror's centre aimed forward, small reliquary niches along the sides, no wheels and no legs

A star wisp, one small flying forest spirit: a round seed-pod body of pale living wood around a small crystal heart, four broad translucent leaf-shaped wings spread like a dragonfly's, two small dark eyes, a few short root tendrils trailing beneath and a cluster of thorny seed pods tucked under its belly, in level flight, nothing touching the ground

A great sand-engine, a crawling fortress-machine: a tall stepped hull of huge riveted brass drums and dark iron plates on six enormous broad iron-shod wheels, a great brass bell in an open domed belfry on the roof, a wide glass-furnace maw behind a heavy iron grille jutting from the front, short chimney stacks, facing forward

A jet lancer seated on a big warhorse, both standing still and facing forward with all four hooves planted: the horse in barding of dark polished plates with two short thruster nozzles on its hindquarters, the rider in heavy lamellar and a pointed fur-trimmed helmet with a face mask, a three-metre lance held upright with a thin glowing line along its long blade

The Forgefather, a colossal walking mountain-forge: a giant of carved stone blocks bound in dark plates, a barrel chest with a forge furnace behind an iron grate, chimney stacks on its shoulders, its right forearm a forge cannon, its left arm a huge forge hammer, a helmed head with a stone beard, pillar-like legs, facing forward

A starstag rider, a forest warden seated on a tall white stag, both standing still and facing forward with all four hooves planted: the stag's great branching antlers made of living clear violet crystal, the rider in a hooded cloak over armour of bark and hardened leather, a bronze circlet, both hands on the reins; the stag with a fur saddle cloth and a leather bridle, no iron anywhere

The Archon, the star given a body, a hovering colossus of a far-advanced age: a towering armoured figure of dark polished adamant and white-enamelled plates with gold trim, a long tapering armoured skirt instead of legs ending just above the ground, two great arms with open gauntlets held slightly out, a large pale crystal heart in its chest, a faceless crowned helm with a thin gold halo ring above it, facing forward

The Bucentaur, the Doge's flagship: a short, tall-sided gilded state galley floating just above the ground on round repulsor pads, no oars and no sails, a long prow ending in a carved lion head, a two-storey deckhouse with arched windows under a gilded canopy roof, long railgun barrels jutting from both broadsides, a squat phaser turret on the roof, facing forward

The War Ordu, the Khagan's palace on wheels: a great domed felt tent palace with a gilded roof crown, built on a massive wagon bed of riveted dark metal rolling on eight huge iron-shod wheels, a railed archer gallery with mounted bow-guns ringing the roof edge, a big war drum on the rear deck, no draught animals, at rest and facing forward
